title: The Slow Horizon
author: O. M. Lockridge
blurb: Emrys Pemberton, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
